title: The Beautiful garden behind the house
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：beautiful　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beautiful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the keeper wrote of ① a beautiful garden behind the house in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more beautiful than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the beautiful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most beautiful garden behind the house anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1967 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too beautiful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the beautiful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a beautiful act of forgiveness, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as beautiful as the act of forgiveness they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was beautiful or not, and he said so.

By 1980 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something beautiful, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite beautiful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the beautiful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1983, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another beautiful garden behind the house in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more beautiful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most beautiful act of forgiveness in the whole tower, she said in 1985, was the one she could never quite name; the beautiful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 美丽（前置定语 a beautiful garden behind the house：1973 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件美丽的园子）
B. adj. 美丽／美好（比较级 more beautiful than：文中两处，一处比屋后的园子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 美丽／美好（最高级 the most beautiful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 美丽（表语 too beautiful to do：母亲觉得它太美丽，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 美好（前置定语 a beautiful act of forgiveness：叔叔把整件事称作一桩美好的宽恕之举）
F. adj. 美好（同级比较 as beautiful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩宽恕之举相比）
G. adj. 美好（后置定语 something beautiful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 美好（受程度副词修饰 quite beautiful：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a beautiful garden behind the house
the most beautiful garden behind the house anybody
The most beautiful act of forgiveness in

answers.why: beautiful 意为“美丽”，1973 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件美丽的园子”，此处作前置定语 a beautiful garden behind the house。
beautiful 意为“美丽”，此处用比较级 more beautiful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
beautiful 意为“美丽”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最美丽的一件，故用最高级 the most beautiful garden behind the house。
beautiful 意为“美丽”，母亲认为这件东西“太美丽了，谁也用不上”，too beautiful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
beautiful 意为“美好”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩美好的宽恕之举”，此处作前置定语 a beautiful act of forgiveness。
beautiful 意为“美好”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩宽恕之举一样美好”，同级比较用 as beautiful as。
beautiful 意为“美好”，年历上那半行字要的是“美好的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something beautiful。
beautiful 意为“美好”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当美好”，quite 修饰原级 beautiful。
beautiful 意为“美好”，1983 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要美好”，故用比较级 more beautiful than。
beautiful 意为“美好”，母亲 1985 年说的是“整个钟楼里最美好的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most beautiful act of forgiveness。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件美丽的园子。（a beautiful garden behind the house）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更美丽。（more beautiful than …）
母亲觉得它太美丽，谁也用不上。（too beautiful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩美好的宽恕之举。（a beautiful act of forgiveness）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩宽恕之举一样美好。（as beautiful as …）
到了 1980 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件美好的东西。（something beautiful）
answers: In 1973 the keeper wrote of a beautiful garden behind the house in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more beautiful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too beautiful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a beautiful act of forgiveness.
He said nobody would call it as beautiful as the act of forgiveness they had once had.
By 1980 the calendar asked for nothing but something beautiful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 beautiful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the keeper wrote of a beautiful garden behind the house in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most beautiful garden behind the house in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too beautiful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a beautiful act of forgiveness, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite beautiful, and everybody laughed.
The beautiful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
